vehicles.title: Demon Hunter
vehicles.chapterTitle: Prologue - The Ghost in the Machine
vehicles.summary: A heavy, predatory hyperbike shaped like a demon hunter's coffin crossed with a fighter jet, built around a pulsing azure Fission Core.
vehicles.design: Deep navy armor, bone-white exhaust pipes, antique bronze trim, skull-like frontal fairing, vertical icy-blue headlight eyes, ribcage tank plates, glowing rim LEDs, wing-spoke wheels, and a segmented cloak-panel tail that echoes Alucard's duster.
vehicles.lore: Fission Void is a machine of vengeance and memory. Its gothic cathedral styling, skull motifs, and sword-shaped internal mechanics turn Alucard's demon-hunting oath into a ride that feels ancient, cursed, and brutally modern.
vehicles.combatUse: Alucard uses it as a pursuit and execution platform, closing distance through ruins and demon territory before launching from the saddle into close-range combat.
vehicles.powerCore: Fission Core turbine-hybrid engine with transparent azure housing and blue coolant lines.
vehicles.personalityFit: Dark, vengeful, disciplined, and built for a hunter who does not retreat.
vehicles.palette: Deep navy, cerulean blue, bone white, antique bronze, icy blue lighting.
vehicles.environment: Ruined gothic cathedral beneath an eternal eclipse, cracked marble, blue mist, rose-window fragments, and ghosted component schematics.
vehicles.mood: Epic, dark, vengeful, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The darkness does not flee. It is executed.
vehicles.quote: They branded my father a traitor. I will carve his honor into the Abyss itself.
vehicles.rideFeel: Heavy, cold, and terrifyingly focused.

vehicles.title: Shining Star
vehicles.chapterTitle: Prologue - The Cannon from the Skies
vehicles.summary: A luminous Eruditio hypercar that channels Layla's long-range Malefic energy into a clean, heroic, sky-city racing weapon.
vehicles.design: Crisp white bodywork, royal blue aero channels, gold structural frames, teal crystalline lighting, a visible Malefic Core, elegant cannon-inspired rear architecture, and glowing rim details.
vehicles.lore: Malefic Star is a tribute to Layla's parents and the airborne dream of Eruditio. It converts scholar-grade engineering into a vehicle that can protect a city from the horizon.
vehicles.combatUse: The car stabilizes long-range firing lines, scans distant threats, and deploys recoil-dampening fields so Layla can turn motion into marksmanship.
vehicles.powerCore: Malefic Core battery with crystalline teal energy routing.
vehicles.personalityFit: Bright, heroic, inventive, and brave enough to race toward danger.
vehicles.palette: Crisp white, royal blue, radiant gold, crystalline teal lighting.
vehicles.environment: Floating city, high-tech sky roads, clean sunlight, lens flares, and airship-inspired architecture.
vehicles.mood: Bright, hopeful, precise, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: From the skies, I watch. From the skies, I strike.
vehicles.quote: My parents built an airship to touch the stars. I built this to protect the city that remembers them.
vehicles.rideFeel: Clean, confident, and tuned for perfect range.

vehicles.title: Priestess of the Moon
vehicles.formalTitle: The Priestess of the Moon's Chariot
vehicles.summary: A solemn moonlit hypercar with crescent geometry, icy-blue particles, and a sacred temple presence made for Miya's thousand-year vigilance.
vehicles.design: Midnight blue bodywork, silver crescent grille, pale lilac cabin glow, moonstone lighting, flowing elven body lines, arrowlike aero blades, and soft particle streams.
vehicles.lore: Lunar Aegis turns Miya's sacred duty into a silent, ceremonial machine. It is less a car than a moon-temple relic made to move.
vehicles.combatUse: Miya uses it to glide through moonlit forests, vanish into projection trails, and reposition for arrow volleys before enemies understand where she went.
vehicles.powerCore: Condensed lunar crystal synchronized with the Lunar Aegis.
vehicles.personalityFit: Graceful, patient, sacred, and deadly when the moon calls.
vehicles.palette: Midnight blue, silver, pale lilac, icy blue light.
vehicles.environment: Sacred elven temple road, moonlit forest, mist, glowing particles, and holographic archive-like afterimages.
vehicles.mood: Mystical, solemn, powerful, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: By the light of the moon, I draw. By the will of the moon, I loose.
vehicles.quote: For a thousand years I watched from the temple. Now the Abyss expands again. The moon's arrow will fly.
vehicles.rideFeel: Silent, floating, and precise as an arrow in moonlight.

vehicles.title: Lightning Weaver
vehicles.summary: A cold, lonely stormhawk helicopter that weaponizes Eudora's lightning into cyan rotor fields, electric arcs, and surgical aerial judgment.
vehicles.design: Deep navy fuselage, crisp white cockpit frame, glowing cyan rotor energy, exposed storm core, arc-shaped weapon lines, and sharp military-magical silhouette.
vehicles.lore: Thunder's Wrath represents Eudora mastering the storm that once isolated her. The machine does not contain her lightning; it gives it direction.
vehicles.combatUse: It controls airspace, marks targets with storm arcs, and delivers overwhelming burst strikes from above before repositioning through charged rotor fields.
vehicles.powerCore: Electromantic storm core feeding cyan rotor fields and weapon arcs.
vehicles.personalityFit: Elegant, dangerous, isolated, and absolute.
vehicles.palette: Deep navy, crisp white, glowing cyan, cold electric highlights.
vehicles.environment: High-tech magical hangar, storm clouds, electric haze, and military schematic afterimages.
vehicles.mood: Cold, powerful, lonely, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: I do not summon the storm. I am the storm.
vehicles.quote: For years they feared my lightning. Now they will pray for its mercy.
vehicles.rideFeel: Like flying inside the eye of a controlled storm.

vehicles.title: Wandering Sword
vehicles.summary: A precise, mournful hover bike with cerulean armor, crimson power lights, orbiting blade modules, and the cold purpose of a manufactured swordsman.
vehicles.design: Cerulean armor, slate grey thrusters, crimson visor headlight, crimson core glow, matte black underbody, and detached sword-like drones that orbit the chassis.
vehicles.lore: Orbiting Sword is a machine haunted by the same laboratory logic that made Saber. It is beautiful in the way a weapon can be beautiful: exact, empty, and terrible.
vehicles.combatUse: It predicts approach vectors, launches Saber into Triple Sweep angles, and releases orbiting sword modules as mobile threat zones.
vehicles.powerCore: Cyborg neural reactor with crimson hover-thruster routing.
vehicles.personalityFit: Cold, precise, mournful, and searching for a memory it cannot name.
vehicles.palette: Cerulean blue, slate grey, crimson lighting, matte black.
vehicles.environment: Dystopian tech gallery, weapon showroom atmosphere, crimson afterimages, and sterile industrial haze.
vehicles.mood: Cold, precise, mournful, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The sword remembers. The sword always remembers.
vehicles.quote: They erased my name. They erased my memories. They erased everything that made me human. But they could not erase the blade.
vehicles.rideFeel: Silent, exact, and unnervingly fast.

vehicles.title: Panda Warrior
vehicles.summary: A peaceful but massive rolling fortress with white armor, bamboo tan structure, emerald light, and the stubborn kindness of Akai's dream.
vehicles.design: Crisp white tank armor, charcoal reactive blocks, bamboo-tan cannon wrap, emerald lights, orange gourd-shaped core, rounded defensive silhouette, and warm eco-military detailing.
vehicles.lore: Heavy Spin is the answer to everyone who laughed at Akai. It is not built to conquer; it is built to shield the village that underestimated him.
vehicles.combatUse: It rolls into enemy formations, anchors lanes, projects defensive pressure, and turns Akai's spinning disruption into armored terrain control.
vehicles.powerCore: Gourd-shaped pressure core with bamboo turbine support.
vehicles.personalityFit: Warm, sturdy, protective, and stronger than it first appears.
vehicles.palette: White, charcoal black, emerald green, bamboo tan, warm orange.
vehicles.environment: Eco-military expo setting, bamboo structures, warm light, and giant technical display screens.
vehicles.mood: Peaceful, powerful, warm, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The boulder does not fall. The boulder rolls forward.
vehicles.quote: They laughed at my dream. Now my shadow covers their village - not to harm, but to shield.
vehicles.rideFeel: Slow to anger, impossible to move.

vehicles.title: Wings of Healing
vehicles.formalTitle: The Wings of Healing's Celestial Chariot
vehicles.conceptType: Celestial chariot drawn by a divine unicorn
vehicles.summary: A holy hover chariot drawn by a divine winged unicorn, glowing with cyan healing trails and polished gold mercy.
vehicles.design: Pure white unicorn, warm ivory wings tipped in gold, polished golden horn and hooves, cyan healing glow, celestial hover chariot frame, featherlike forms, and sanctuary-grade ornament.
vehicles.lore: Divine Resurrection carries Rafaela's sorrow and mercy together. Its light is beautiful, but the machine remembers why healing is needed.
vehicles.combatUse: It crosses battlefields as a rescue platform, expanding healing fields, guiding fallen allies, and creating a sacred channel for Rafaela's resurrection power.
vehicles.powerCore: Celestial hymn crystal amplified through unicorn horn and hover chariot halo.
vehicles.personalityFit: Gentle, divine, melancholic, and unbreakably hopeful.
vehicles.palette: Pure white, polished gold, warm ivory, healing cyan.
vehicles.environment: Holy sanctuary, luminous archive light, soft clouds, wing trails, and reverent holographic detail studies.
vehicles.mood: Peaceful, divine, melancholic, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: Where there is faith, there is healing. Where there is healing, there is hope.
vehicles.quote: My brother fell into darkness because the world loved only me. I carry his memory in every light I summon.
vehicles.rideFeel: Soft, luminous, and impossibly steady.

vehicles.title: Frozen Warrior
vehicles.conceptType: Futuristic Viking sled pulled by frozen wyrms
vehicles.summary: A dark iron hover sled dragged by two chained frozen wyrms, made for Franco's brutal hunts across storm shelves and pirate ice.
vehicles.design: Dark iron armor, weathered bronze rivets, frosted steel thrusters, deep crimson harness chains and runes, icy-blue plasma, ram-like front plating, and twin frost wyrm beasts with chained harnesses.
vehicles.lore: Iron Hook is Franco's frozen authority made physical. The sled and wyrms turn the Northern Vale into his hunting ground, dragging monsters and criminals toward justice.
vehicles.combatUse: Franco braces on the sled deck, fires harpoons, uses the wyrms' pulling force to rip enemies from safety, and turns frozen terrain into a moving execution lane.
vehicles.powerCore: Hover-sled plasma thrusters pulled and stabilized by chained frost wyrms.
vehicles.personalityFit: Brutal, relentless, loud, and impossible to stop once the chain catches.
vehicles.palette: Dark iron, weathered bronze, frosted steel, deep crimson, icy blue.
vehicles.environment: Frozen northern warfield, ice cliffs, storm snow, chained beast trails, and hololithic war-chief archive atmosphere.
vehicles.mood: Brutal, frozen, relentless, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The cold does not kill. The cold is my ally.
vehicles.quote: I lost my arm to a criminal king. I will drag every monster in this world to justice - by chain or by hook.
vehicles.rideFeel: A roaring slide pulled by monsters that want to bite the horizon.

vehicles.title: Kung Fu Boy
vehicles.formalTitle: The Kung Fu Boy's Roaring Steed
vehicles.summary: A matte charcoal superbike with electric yellow aggression and a glowing dragon aura built for Chou's street-fight momentum.
vehicles.design: Matte charcoal body, electric yellow decals and calipers, gold chi particles, dragon-whisker light strips, a single white headlight eye, scale-like panels, and tail-shaped exhaust aura.
vehicles.lore: The Way of Dragon carries Chou's rise from mocked poverty to urban legend. It is not luxury; it is movement, confidence, and fighting spirit turned into a machine.
vehicles.combatUse: Chou drifts into impossible angles, vaults from the superbike into Jeet Kune Do, and leaves a roaring dragon silhouette behind each launch kick.
vehicles.powerCore: Kinetic chi turbine fed by speed, breath rhythm, and impact pressure.
vehicles.personalityFit: Aggressive, stylish, scrappy, and full of street-hero confidence.
vehicles.palette: Matte charcoal black, electric yellow, glowing gold, white headlight eye.
vehicles.environment: Neon underground street fight tournament, wet pavement, urban smoke, gold aura trails, and cyber-dojo atmosphere.
vehicles.mood: Aggressive, neon-drenched, mystical, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The dragon sleeps in every punch. Wake it.
vehicles.quote: They mocked my rags. They laughed at my dream. Now the streets bow to my kick.
vehicles.rideFeel: Sharp, loud, and alive with combo energy.

vehicles.title: Sweet Leonin
vehicles.summary: The smallest and fastest ride in the bay: a hot-pink magical supercar with a royal-purple rear wing, Molina sparkles, and absurd speed.
vehicles.design: Hot pink body, magenta glow, royal purple rear wing, gold boomerang ornaments, paw-buckle details, soft cyan Molina spirit effects, rounded cute bodywork, oversized wheels, and dreamlike sparkle trails.
vehicles.lore: Molina's Gift is Nana's memory of her lost friend transformed into motion. It is sweet, nostalgic, and dangerously fast, like a child's dream that learned how to outrun grief.
vehicles.combatUse: Nana zips through fights in a pink blur, drops Molina decoys, turns sharply on magical wing downforce, and escapes through gaps no larger vehicle can use.
vehicles.powerCore: Molina spirit turbo, moonfruit spark cells, and pink boost charms.
vehicles.personalityFit: Cute, chaotic, loyal, tiny, and far faster than anyone expects.
vehicles.palette: Hot pink, magenta, royal purple, gold, soft cyan.
vehicles.environment: Magical dream garage, enchanted forest lights, floating sparkles, toylike nostalgia, and soft fantasy bokeh.
vehicles.mood: Sweet, nostalgic, magical, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: Every spell is a memory. Every memory is a gift.
vehicles.quote: Molina gave me his life so I could keep mine. Now I ride with him beside me - always.
vehicles.rideFeel: Adorable until the boost hits.

vehicles.title: Protector
vehicles.summary: A heroic one-wheeled kinetic hover bike built around Bruno's soccer-born momentum, cybernetic legs, and arena-champion energy.
vehicles.design: Charcoal armor, silver mechanical struts, cerulean power core lines, amber cockpit lighting, turquoise energy wheel, hydraulic leg-like supports, and athletic Eruditio design cues.
vehicles.lore: Wave of the World fuses Dr. Rooney's engineering with Bruno's love of soccer. It is a cyber-athlete's hall-of-fame machine, built to honor the boy who kept running after losing his legs.
vehicles.combatUse: Bruno uses the kinetic bike to build speed, curve through enemy formations, launch precision angles, and turn every approach into the setup for a supercharged kick.
vehicles.powerCore: Turquoise kinetic wheel reactor synced to Bruno's mechanical leg rhythm.
vehicles.personalityFit: Energetic, heroic, athletic, and full of forward motion.
vehicles.palette: Charcoal grey, silver, cerulean blue, amber, turquoise.
vehicles.environment: Golden arena, dust, cyber-athlete showcase lighting, kinetic trails, and stadium-like heroic framing.
vehicles.mood: Energetic, heroic, warm, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: One kick can change the game. One game can change the world.
vehicles.quote: I was born frail. They gave me steel. Now I run so that others don't have to fall.
vehicles.rideFeel: Fast, warm, and charged like a game-winning kick.

vehicles.title: West Justice
vehicles.summary: A heroic armored stallion with sheriff-star barding, rifle scabbards, glowing blue-grey eyes, and the lonely dignity of frontier justice.
vehicles.design: Dark charcoal horse coat, tan leather barding, silver hat-helmet, V emblem, feather detail, crimson bandana, sheriff breastplate, brass cartridges, repeater rifles, revolving cannons, armored greaves, and spurred steel hooves.
vehicles.lore: West Justice embodies Clint's lawman code after exile. When the town abandoned him, the steed remained: a symbol that justice is not a crowd's approval, but a duty carried forward.
vehicles.combatUse: Clint rides the stallion through frontier roads, using speed, firing lines, rifle scabbards, and cavalry positioning to dominate dusty corridors and duel zones.
vehicles.powerCore: Subtle heroic enhancement through tactical vision eyes and reinforced frontier armor.
vehicles.personalityFit: Stoic, lawful, weathered, and unshakably loyal.
vehicles.palette: Dark charcoal grey, tan leather, silver, brass, deep crimson, blue-grey eye glow.
vehicles.environment: Desert sunset, cracked earth, mesas, cacti silhouettes, dusty heat haze, and frontier gunsmith afterimages.
vehicles.mood: Heroic, dusty, warm, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: Justice is not a bullet. It is the hand that aims it.
vehicles.quote: They exiled me for doing right. But a good lawman never abandons his duty - nor his horse.
vehicles.rideFeel: Steady, dusty, loyal, and ready at the draw.

vehicles.title: Professor of the Mystics
vehicles.summary: A compact one-man spaceship shaped like a floating arcane rune, powered by mystic plasma, anti-gravity pylons, and a cyan engine ring.
vehicles.design: Obsidian black faceted hull panels, deep violet plasma conduits, cyan edge lighting, a pure white forward sensor orb, purple anti-gravity sparks, and a rear ring engine that trails comet-like particles.
vehicles.lore: Mystic Gush embodies Gord's forbidden pursuit of transcendence. It is a professor's experiment turned vessel: elegant, unstable, and touched by the chaos he once feared.
vehicles.combatUse: Gord uses it as an aerial arcane artillery platform, hovering above impossible terrain while the sensor orb focuses mystic energy into long-range pressure.
vehicles.powerCore: Cyan arcane ring engine fed by deep-violet mystic plasma conduits.
vehicles.personalityFit: Brilliant, tragic, cosmic, and dangerously curious.
vehicles.palette: Deep violet, obsidian black, glowing cyan, pure white, subtle gold, purple sparks.
vehicles.environment: Crumbling celestial temple, cosmic nebula, floating ruins, mystic academy relics, and holographic arcane component studies.
vehicles.mood: Cosmic, tragic, powerful, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The experiment was forbidden. The power was infinite. The price was everything.
vehicles.quote: I sought to transcend flesh. Instead, I became a vessel for the very chaos I feared.
vehicles.rideFeel: Weightless, brilliant, and one bad calculation from infinity.

vehicles.title: Genius Mage
vehicles.summary: An ornate floating magician's throne with brass clockwork, crimson velvet, emerald levitation orbs, and rotating golden clock hands.
vehicles.design: Polished mahogany frame, brass gears and armrests, dark velvet crimson upholstery, emerald magical orbs, ruby headrest gem, soft gold particles, and theatrical Victorian magician styling.
vehicles.lore: Deadly Magic is Harley's private-study ego made airborne: clever, excessive, mischievous, and far more dangerous than its cozy upholstery suggests.
vehicles.combatUse: Harley rides the throne as a mobile casting seat, throwing cards, warping angles, and using rotating clock hands as misdirection and timing anchors.
vehicles.powerCore: Emerald levitation orbs synchronized with brass clockwork and card magic.
vehicles.personalityFit: Mischievous, elegant, brilliant, and cheerfully reckless.
vehicles.palette: Polished mahogany, polished brass, dark velvet crimson, emerald green, ruby red, soft gold.
vehicles.environment: Grand dim library, magical academy study, floating books, warm candlelight, and clockwork arcane schematics.
vehicles.mood: Mischievous, elegant, magical, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: Every trick is a lesson. Every lesson is a new trick.
vehicles.quote: They said I was too young, too reckless. But genius doesn't wait for permission.
vehicles.rideFeel: Like sitting in a parlor chair that knows every trick before you do.

vehicles.title: Bloody Beast
vehicles.summary: An ultra-wide blood-red monster car with spiked rims, hellfire exhausts, and the raw silhouette of an orcish beast in metal form.
vehicles.design: Deep crimson bodywork, volcanic black roof and diffuser, glowing orange tribal markings, dark spiked rims, deep purple canopy glass, and three massive curved rear exhaust pipes venting hellfire.
vehicles.lore: Savage Roar is Balmond's demon-blood fury given wheels. It does not look engineered so much as forged in an angry furnace and released before it cooled.
vehicles.combatUse: Balmond uses it to break formations, roar through scorched terrain, and carry Cyclone Sweep momentum into a brutal frontal charge.
vehicles.powerCore: Hellfire engine deck with orange tribal energy veins and triple exhaust flame stacks.
vehicles.personalityFit: Savage, blunt, furious, and impossible to civilize.
vehicles.palette: Blood red, volcanic black, glowing orange, matte dark grey, deep purple glass.
vehicles.environment: Demonic hellscape, fiery vortex, volcanic ground, ash, smoke, and war-chief garage atmosphere.
vehicles.mood: Brutal, apocalyptic, fiery, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The beast does not ask for mercy. The beast takes everything.
vehicles.quote: I drank demon blood to save my people. Now I burn the world to keep that promise.
vehicles.rideFeel: Less like driving and more like being dragged by rage.

vehicles.title: Son of Minos
vehicles.formalTitle: The Son of Minos's Rolling Labyrinth
vehicles.summary: A colossal volcanic tank with a bull-head turret, twin magma throwers, lava-vein armor, and the grief of a fallen kingdom.
vehicles.design: Dark volcanic stone armor, terracotta plates, glowing orange lava veins, bone-white tusks and spikes, black tracks, eight road wheels per side, and a sloping turret shaped like a raging bull.
vehicles.lore: Minoan Rage is Minotaur's labyrinth and burden turned into steel. It carries the kingdom he lost and the rage he can never fully silence.
vehicles.combatUse: The tank advances like a moving wall, projecting molten pressure through twin barrels while its heavy armor absorbs punishment for allies.
vehicles.powerCore: Molten labyrinth furnace feeding twin magma throwers and lava-vein reactive plates.
vehicles.personalityFit: Tragic, massive, protective, and terrifying when fury wakes.
vehicles.palette: Volcanic grey, terracotta red, glowing orange, bone white, matte black.
vehicles.environment: Minoan labyrinth, smoky sky, ancient stone corridors, black embers, and fallen-civilization war museum framing.
vehicles.mood: Tragic, brutal, volcanic, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The labyrinth could not hold me. Neither will your armies.
vehicles.quote: I killed my own father in a moment of rage. Now I carry his kingdom on my back - in steel and fire.
vehicles.rideFeel: A slow volcanic heartbeat with a kingdom's weight behind it.

vehicles.title: Queen of Blood
vehicles.formalTitle: The Queen of Blood's Shadow Chariot
vehicles.summary: A low, predatory levitating hybrid with crimson plasma jets, demonic facework, bat-wing stabilizers, and fang-shaped afterburners.
vehicles.design: Deep crimson body, obsidian underbody and cockpit trim, magenta plasma jets and eyes, pale bone-white fangs and horn tips, dark translucent canopy, and massive leathery bat-wing stabilizers.
vehicles.lore: Blood Ode is Alice's throne without a throne room. It glides above the ground like a blood song, elegant enough for royalty and cruel enough for the Abyss.
vehicles.combatUse: Alice uses it to hover into ritual zones, drain attention, reposition with crimson jets, and turn every arrival into a predatory declaration.
vehicles.powerCore: Crimson plasma hover jets and internal blood-light reactor.
vehicles.personalityFit: Elegant, predatory, gothic, and hungry for remembrance.
vehicles.palette: Blood red, obsidian black, magenta, pale bone white.
vehicles.environment: Blood moon, ritual platform, gothic castle shadows, crimson mist, and dark royal archive atmosphere.
vehicles.mood: Elegant, predatory, gothic, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: Every drop of blood spilled is a note in my eternal song.
vehicles.quote: They called me the forgotten daughter. Now I am the only queen this realm will remember.
vehicles.rideFeel: Smooth, predatory, and too quiet for something so dangerous.

vehicles.title: Spear of the Dragon
vehicles.formalTitle: The Spear of the Dragon's Auspicious Cloud
vehicles.conceptType: Celestial cloud vehicle with elemental dragon companions
vehicles.summary: A divine xiangyun cloud platform surrounded by a spectral Eastern dragon and five elemental dragon companions.
vehicles.design: Layered white-gold cloud platform, curled vapor edges, warm golden underglow, cyan spectral dragon aura, gold mane and horns, and five elemental dragon babies orbiting like sacred companions.
vehicles.lore: Supreme Warrior is Zilong's blessing from the Great Dragon made rideable. It does not chase enemies; it arrives with celestial certainty.
vehicles.combatUse: Zilong rides the cloud into battle lines, using the spectral dragon aura to protect his approach and elemental companions to frame his spear charges.
vehicles.powerCore: Golden auspicious cloud core protected by cyan spectral dragon energy.
vehicles.personalityFit: Heroic, serene, dutiful, and blessed by divine motion.
vehicles.palette: Shimmering white, soft gold, translucent cyan, elemental companion colors.
vehicles.environment: Celestial realm, starry sky, heavenly hall, golden mist, and divine hero archive composition.
vehicles.mood: Heroic, serene, divine, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The dragon does not chase. The dragon arrives.
vehicles.quote: I was taken from my family, given to the Great Dragon. Now I ride these clouds so no other child has to lose their home.
vehicles.rideFeel: Silent, divine, and suddenly everywhere.

vehicles.title: Steel Elf
vehicles.summary: A bulky, heroic police interceptor superbike with a hammer-head shield fairing, Noumenon Energy Core, rugged tires, and ranger-grade utility gear.
vehicles.design: Matte charcoal bodywork, silver shield fairing and swingarm, vibrant orange hammer accents, icy-blue headlight and strobe lights, brass rivets, leather straps, and a rear utility chest with compact hammer counterweight.
vehicles.lore: Guardian's Reflection turns Lolita's gentle courage into a road guardian. It is built to chase danger, shield civilians, and carry the heart of a small elf with impossible resolve.
vehicles.combatUse: Lolita uses the interceptor to block pursuit lanes, ram through danger with the shield fairing, and deploy Noumenon Blast energy from a stabilized pursuit platform.
vehicles.powerCore: Noumenon Energy Core mounted in the armored fuel tank.
vehicles.personalityFit: Protective, calm, heroic, and sturdier than its rider looks.
vehicles.palette: Matte charcoal black, silver, vibrant orange, icy blue, brass, dark grey.
vehicles.environment: Ranger headquarters, high-speed city roads, blue-white pursuit lights, and heroic police-garage atmosphere.
vehicles.mood: Protective, calm, heroic, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: Gentleness is not weakness. It is the strongest shield.
vehicles.quote: They gave me steel and a core of light. I give them my heart - and this road.
vehicles.rideFeel: Stable, brave, and always between danger and someone smaller.

vehicles.title: Crimson Shadow
vehicles.summary: A blood-red phantom hyperbike with matte charcoal panels, a shuriken rear wing, ninja flag, and lethal shadow-road presence.
vehicles.design: Deep gloss crimson bodywork, matte charcoal frame and rear wing, silver engine accents, crimson headlight glow, black wheels with red accents, and a Shadow Sect flag flying from a shuriken-shaped tail wing.
vehicles.lore: Crimson Shadow carries Hayabusa's revenge with poetic restraint. It is built for the instant between silence and the strike.
vehicles.combatUse: Hayabusa uses the bike for high-speed infiltration, shadow feints, and sudden entries before vanishing into crimson smoke trails.
vehicles.powerCore: Shadow-tuned crimson engine with silent acceleration channels.
vehicles.personalityFit: Melancholic, disciplined, lethal, and bound to revenge.
vehicles.palette: Blood red, matte charcoal black, silver, crimson glow, dark grey tires.
vehicles.environment: Cherry blossom forest, distant mountains, hidden ninja base atmosphere, drifting petals, and red smoke trails.
vehicles.mood: Melancholic, lethal, poetic, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The shadow does not wait. The shadow strikes.
vehicles.quote: I lost my brother to a rogue's blade. Now every shadow I cast carries my revenge.
vehicles.rideFeel: A red shadow with an engine note you hear too late.

vehicles.title: Valkyrie
vehicles.summary: A floating winged longboat chariot pulled by three gold-armored white bears, radiant with divine Nordic power.
vehicles.design: Polished silver hull, serpent prow, gold filigree, swan-like side wings, ice-blue runes, translucent navy canopy, and three massive armored white bears with blue gemstone plates.
vehicles.lore: Svalinn's Aegis is Freya's second life made ceremonial: the Aesir's gift, the North's memory, and a divine vehicle for reclaiming home.
vehicles.combatUse: Freya descends into battle from the chariot, using bear-driven momentum and icy rune light to break enemy lines before leaping into melee.
vehicles.powerCore: Valkyrie spear hitch and divine rune lift beneath the longboat hull.
vehicles.personalityFit: Epic, divine, loyal, and fierce enough to make the North kneel in respect.
vehicles.palette: Polished silver, radiant gold, ice blue, pure white, deep navy.
vehicles.environment: Cracked ice, frozen divine hall, northern aurora light, and great hall of the gods atmosphere.
vehicles.mood: Epic, divine, frozen, and cinematic.
vehicles.catchphrase: The gods chose me. The bears carry me. The North will remember me.
vehicles.quote: I died fighting a demon. The Aesir gave me wings. Now I ride with beasts of gold to reclaim my home.
vehicles.rideFeel: Majestic, heavy with destiny, and thunderous on ice.

vehicles.title: Shadow Blade
vehicles.summary: A silent obsidian-violet hoverbike with a shadow-elf mask fairing, living vine framework, and a pulsing Shadow Core.
vehicles.design: Obsidian purple-black metal, darkwood panels, cyan runes, luminous green anti-gravity pods, living vines with glowing leaves, silver mask edges, and violet slit-eye headlights.

Three swept‑back wings on each side (total six wing surfaces) radiate from the mid‑section, each blade‑like and serrated. The craft is approximately 45 meters long, 30 meters wingspan, and hovers 10 meters above the ground. Obsidian black (primary hull). Deep crimson (armor trim, wing edges). Glowing violet (cockpit slit, plasma thrusters, energy veins). Magenta (pulsing conduits, third‑eye glow). Silver (mandible claws, weapon rack details). Matte dark grey (underbelly). The violet cockpit slit glows steadily. The plasma thrusters vent bright violet flame. The magenta veins pulse slowly (10% brightness oscillation). The weapon racks have a faint internal glow. The ship is surrounded by a faint, shimmering dark aura with small violet embers.

vehicles.design: A sleek, angular, single‑rotor attack helicopter with a low, aggressive profile and a menacing, ethereal aesthetic. The main rotor is a four‑bladed system where each blade is a semi‑translucent, glowing cerulean energy blade that crackles with abyssal lightning, rather than solid metal. The tail rotor is a similar energy disc. The helicopter has no visible weapon barrels – instead, it has two forward‑facing energy cannons that emerge from the fuselage like glowing crystalline shards (inspired by Brody’s energy arm). The rear has two large, vertical exhaust fins that vent shimmering, ghostly blue mist. The entire body is painted in obsidian black with deep crimson trim and gold geometric runes etched into the panels. The helicopter is approximately 12 meters long, 3 meters wide, 3.5 meters tall (rotor height), and hovers 2 meters above the ground. Obsidian black (primary body). Deep crimson (trim, accents). The balloon is adorned with a giant, smiling patchwork rabbit face (Pom) on the front: two large, button eyes (one blue, one pink), a stitched pink nose, and a curved, stitched smile. Two long, floppy rabbit ears extend from the top of the envelope, made of the same patchwork fabric and lined with pink satin. The basket is a woven wicker circle, painted pastel blue, with a cushioned rim (pink velvet) and a small, heart‑shaped wooden door. The basket is decorated with hanging stuffed toys (mini dolls), glowing fairy lights (tiny warm white bulbs), and a small, brass lantern. A trailing ribbon of glowing pink thread extends from the back of the basket, fluttering in the wind. The balloon is tethered to a carved wooden anchor (shaped like a giant knitting needle) on the ground. Overall height approximately 12 meters, width 7 meters. Cotton candy pink (primary patchwork). Buttercup yellow (secondary patches). Sky blue (accent patches). Lavender (ear linings, trim). Cream white (base fabric). Warm white (fairy lights). Polished brass (lantern, rings, anchor tip). Brown wicker (basket). Dark brown (stitching thread). The balloon is illuminated by the warm, golden light of a setting sun, with soft pink and purple clouds behind it. The fairy lights and brass lantern add warm, twinkling highlights. The glowing pink thread leaves a faint, sparkling trail. Small, floating heart particles (translucent pink) drift around the balloon.

vehicles.title: Cosmic Wayfinder
vehicles.summary: A sleek, classic café‑racer‑inspired superbike with a long, low teardrop fuel tank, a rounded front fairing, and a bobbed tail.
vehicles.design: A sleek, classic café‑racer‑inspired superbike with a long, low teardrop fuel tank, a rounded front fairing, and a bobbed tail. The bike has no wheels — it hovers on four anti‑gravity pods (two front, two rear) that glow with violet plasma. The body is matte cosmic silver with deep navy blue side panels and gold pinstriping. The front is a classic round headlight (violet LED) with a gold mesh grille. The handlebars are low clip‑ons with brown leather grips. The bike has three seats: a central rider’s saddle (black leather, gold stitching), a left side‑mounted floating panel seat (a small, wing‑like platform with a leather pad and a backrest, hovering just off the left flank), and a right side‑mounted floating panel seat (same design). Each side seat is attached by a thin, invisible magnetic arm from the main frame. The bike has four exhaust pipes: two stacked on the left side, two stacked on the right side (double exhausts both sides), each a brushed silver cylinder with a glowing violet tip and venting a thin, shimmering purple‑cyan mist. The rear has a split tail fin (two sharp points) with a glowing violet energy vein. The wheels are replaced by solid disc covers (matte black) with rotating violet LED rings. The bike is approximately 2.2 meters long, 1.2 meters wide (with side seats extended), 1.0 meters tall, and hovers 25 cm above the ground. Matte cosmic silver (primary body). Deep navy blue (side panels, underbody). Glowing violet (headlight, exhaust tips, hover pads, energy vein). Polished gold (pinstripes, wheel rings, emblem). Brushed silver (exhaust pipes, handlebar). The windscreen is a low, curved panel of reinforced glass (dark tinted) with a gold frame, etched with stylized wind swirls. The car is decorated with flowing, wind‑current decals (translucent cyan and white) along the sides. The disc wheels are replaced by solid silver covers with spinning cyan LED rings. The car floats approximately 30 cm above the ground. Length approximately 4.7 meters, width 2.2 meters (with wing fins), height 1.0 meters. Pearl white (primary body).
